pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with distinct but soft edge gradients due to resolution. Patches on the lower neck are larger and more elongated, while flank patches are smaller and more irregularly geometric.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily trifurcated. The thickness of the pathways remains relatively uniform across the visible flank and neck surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dense fringe along the neck ridge forming a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.
